title.narrative: Promoting electric mobility in Papua New Guinea

description.narrative: The Government of PNG (GoPNG) has set an ambitious goal of achieving greenhouse gas emission reduction of at least 50% by 2030 and 100% carbon neutrality by 2050 in its key climate change policies including the enhanced NDC 2020.Electric mobility has been viewed by the GoPNGas a priority that contributes to reducing GHG in the transport sector.Some work and analysis have been undertaken with support from CTCN to identify barriers that need to be addressed in the short, medium and long-term as well as recommendations for electric vehicle policy development. More work will be required to establish an overarching policy framework and roadmap to create an enabling environment for a paradigm shift towards a low emission transportation in PNG and sustainable e-mobility deployment.Building on preliminary work by CTCN, this GCF readiness grant will focus on undertakingadditional studies and assessments to finalize the Electric Vehicle Policy and Implementation Roadmap for Papua New Guinea, making revisions to relevant regulations as needed to facilitate deployment of EVs, and formulating the National EV communication strategy to raise awareness on EVs.
